command: git rev-list --all | while read rev; do git grep -Il -E "BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY|(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,}|gh[pousr]_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|cred:v1:[0-9A-Za-z:_-]+|Bearer[[:space:]]+[0-9A-Za-z._~+/-]{12,})" "$rev" -- . || true; done | cut -d: -f2- | sort -u
